title: Critical Care II
description: Mechanical ventilation fundamentals through weaning: indications, modes, NIV, initiation, monitoring, graphics, patient transport, and ventilator discontinuation.

lessons.title: Indications, Goals & Hazards of Mechanical Ventilation
lessons.description: Type I (hypoxemic) and Type II (hypercapnic) respiratory failure, V/Q mismatch versus shunt, bedside ventilatory parameters, physiologic measurements, contraindications, goals, and hazards of mechanical ventilation.

resources.title: Why Do We Need MV? — Type I Respiratory Failure (LibreTexts)
resources.description: Open-access RT student resource on hypoxemic respiratory failure: V/Q mismatch, shunt, diffusion impairment, and P(A-a)O₂.

resources.title: Why Do We Need MV? — Type II Respiratory Failure (LibreTexts)
resources.description: Open-access RT student resource on hypercapnic respiratory failure: decreased drive, muscle weakness, and altered mechanics.

lessons.title: Ventilator Classification & Modes of Ventilation
lessons.description: Input power, drive mechanisms, control variables (pressure/volume/flow/time), phase variables, breath types, and modes: CMV/A-C, SIMV, CSV/CPAP, PSV, and APRV.

resources.title: Mechanical Ventilation — StatPearls (NIH)
resources.description: Evidence-based clinical reference on ventilator classification, modes, and breath types including SIMV, PSV, and APRV.

resources.title: Synchronized Intermittent Mandatory Ventilation — StatPearls (NIH)
resources.description: Dedicated StatPearls article on SIMV: physiology, indication, weaning applications, and comparison with other modes.

lessons.title: Non-Invasive Ventilation (NIV)
lessons.description: NIV indications, contraindications, interfaces (nasal/full-face/total-face/helmet), CPAP vs. BiPAP, S/T mode, AVAPS, initial application procedure, and troubleshooting common side effects.

resources.title: NIV for Acute Cardiogenic Pulmonary Edema and COPD — PMC
resources.description: Review of CPAP and BiPAP evidence in prehospital and emergency settings; covers indications, settings, and outcomes.

lessons.title: Initiating & Adjusting Ventilatory Support
lessons.description: Mode selection, IBW-based tidal volume calculation, ARDS lung-protective strategy, mechanical and physiologic dead space, PIFR, I-time, I:E ratio, PEEP/FiO₂ management, pressure support, alarms, and ABG-guided adjustments.

resources.title: ARDSNet Trial — Wiki Journal Club
resources.description: Plain-language summary of the landmark ARDSNet study establishing lung-protective ventilation at 6 mL/kg IBW with Pplat < 30 cmH₂O.

resources.title: Dead Space, Tidal Volume & Protective Ventilation — CoEMV
resources.description: Detailed breakdown of instrumental, anatomic, and alveolar dead space and how protective ventilation settings affect VD/VT.

lessons.title: Monitoring, Ventilator Graphics & Patient Transport
lessons.description: Monitored values (PIP, MAP, Pplat, driving pressure, auto-PEEP, compliance), ventilator check procedure, pressure/flow/volume scalars, P/V and F/V loops, troubleshooting asynchrony and auto-PEEP, intra/inter-hospital transport, and CCATT.

resources.title: Ventilator Waveforms & Graphics: Interpretation Guide — Respiratory Therapy Zone
resources.description: Comprehensive RT study guide covering all scalar waveforms and loops, with annotated normal and abnormal graphic examples and 100 practice questions.

lessons.title: Weaning, Discontinuation & Module Exam
lessons.description: VAP prevention and circuit change protocols (AARC guidelines), weaning parameters (RSBI, MIP, oxygenation criteria), SBT methods, SBT failure criteria, terminal weaning, brain death evaluation, and the 50-question module exam.

resources.title: Ventilator Weaning and Spontaneous Breathing Trials: Educational Review — PMC
resources.description: Evidence-based review of weaning readiness, RSBI, SBT protocols, and management of SBT failure. Emergency (Tehran), 2016.

resources.title: Optimizing Spontaneous Breathing Trials — GE Healthcare Clinical View
resources.description: Clinical guidance on SBT timing, methodology (T-piece vs. CPAP), and liberation decision-making.

resources.title: Critical Care II — Video Playlist
resources.description: Course video playlist covering mechanical ventilation topics aligned with this module.
